_comment: Plugin hook registration for sage-gate1-pre-decision (the FULL-LOOP harness, H1–H4). Auto-discovered at the plugin root (hooks/hooks.json) on install — no manifest 'hooks' field needed. Same shape as a settings.json 'hooks' block. Paths use ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} (the plugin's install dir) in EXEC form (command:'node' + args:[path]) so the path is passed as one argument with no quoting (plugins-reference: 'In hook commands, use exec form with args'). 'timeout' is SECONDS; the hooks self-abort at 28000ms (< 30s) and return their honest result first. H1 (UserPromptSubmit) frames the top-level task. H2 (PreToolUse matcher Task|Agent) frames each delegated subagent's task. H3 (PreToolUse matcher Bash|Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit) is the R5 at-action cadence — guard (block on do_not_proceed) + Gate-2 consult (deduped) + loop-closure. H4 (Stop) is reflect-at-close + the accreditation write. H1/H2 are LIVE in the founder's dogfood install; H3/H4 are BUILT DARK (Slice 5a) and registered here so a future /plugin install picks them up — they are NOT installed into any settings.local.json until the founder-walked Slice 5b. The consult credential is read from SAGE_GATE1_CREDENTIAL; H4's accreditation write uses a SEPARATE non-marker credential SAGE_GATE1_ACCRED_CREDENTIAL (never the standing marker) + SAGE_GATE1_AGENT_ID. See ../README.md.
